title: Metal Lab Gas Line Service

onscreen_lines.desc: All work, services, materials, installation activities, and deliverables provided under this requirement shall be performed in strict accordance with the requirements set forth in the document titled SAWS_Metals_Lab_SOW 23 Oct 26. The objective is to provide safe, complete, and functional analytical gas line modifications that: (1) extend regulated helium service from Room 126 to a second instrument connection in Room 124; and (2) replace the existing argon and nitrogen terminal assemblies with one simplified customer-furnished assembly for each gas.
onscreen_lines.note: Vendor will submit their approach to satisfying the objective, not to exceed 1 page.
